newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Commerce checking its Feb oil import numbers.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Commerce checking its Feb oil import numbers.

text.p: The Commerce Department was checking its figures for crude petroleum imports in February after receiving several inquiries about the record volumes, a department official said on Thursday.

Earlier in its monthly trade report, Commerce said crude petroleum imports averaged a record 9.33 million barrels a day in February, surpassing the previous record 8.6 million daily set more than a decade ago in September 1986.
"We've gotten calls from people," said Nick Orsini of Bureau of the Census that compiles the data. "We are checking it out ourselves."
Orsini said the figures "stand as published" unless it finds some error.
